title: Focused gate
goal: A push runs only the checks and tests its changed paths can break: tests.py --changed selects test files from a computed map of test files to the tool modules they import or run, kb content runs only the content checks and test_kb.py's content classes, unknown paths run everything, and kbgit.py's gate and kb/_self's gate rules use it.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
